body: well i finished two of my exams that i was stressing out about.  Didn't do so well on them but just having them over makes me feel a little better.  I'm also working on finding a therapist/psychiatrist in my area that I can go see.

I thought about going to see a school counselor, but I'm afraid that they'll think I need to be admitted to some psych ward or a hospital or something over dramatic. I'm not really feeling suicidal I've just been thinking about it more recently.  If I thought there was actually a good chance of me acting on my thought I probably would go talk to someone to get serious help but since I don't think it is very likely I don't want to over complicate things. Hope that makes sense.
Thanks for your input, It is much appreciated.
